name: Loja Highland Quichua
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.source_named: Carpenter, Lawrence Kidd 1982. Ecuadorian Quichua: Descriptive Sketch and Variation. PhD thesis, University of Florida (Glottolog grammar_sketch for loja1235).

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.3 languoid page loja1235 (Loja Highland Quichua; Ecuadorian Quechua B > Colombia-Ecuador Quechua) and StressTyp2 v1 archive (local)
sources.note: Glottolog lists only Stark 1985 (pp. 446-447), Nuckolls 1996 (pp. 19-20) and Campbell et al. 2022 for this languoid; StressTyp2 has no qvj entry (only Imbabura qvi citing Cole 1982 'penultimate, non-distinctive', and a generic Quechua entry citing Adelaar 1984).

sources.citation: Benalcázar Aguas, Doménika Pamela. 2020. El kichwa de Saraguro: implicaciones sociolingüísticas de la estandarización. Tesis de Licenciatura en Antropología, Universidad San Francisco de Quito. 78 pp.
sources.note: Sec. 4.2.1 'Fonética de Saraguro' (pp. 40-49) gives vowel and consonant inventories of Saraguro Kichwa (communities Gera, Oñacapac, San Lucas) and sec. 5.1.1 compares Saraguro phonemes with unified Kichwa graphemes; there is no statement on stress/accent placement (the word 'tónica' appears once, p. 43, only as a positional criterion 'después de una sílaba tónica'; 'acento' never).

sources.citation: Montaluisa Chasiquiza, Luis. 2019. La estandarización ortográfica del quichua ecuatoriano: consideraciones históricas, dialectológicas y sociolingüísticas. Quito: Abya-Yala (SciELO Books; doi 10.7476/9789978104965). [2018 PUCP PhD thesis, hdl 20.500.12404/12268]
sources.note: Dialectological survey with Loja survey points (San Lucas, Saraguro) and a chapter reviewing prior dialect studies (Carpenter 1982 pp. 200-210, Lombeida-Naranjo 1976, Yánez, Stark 1985); segmental variation only. No statement on stress anywhere in the book (only 'acento' hit is about Parker's proto-Quechua 'acento de intensidad'). Notes (p. 201) that Consuelo Yánez did phonological studies of the Chimborazo, Imbabura and Loja dialects in the 1970s.

sources.citation: Burneo Vela, María del Carmen. 2016. Breve análisis de la vitalidad del Kichwa en las comunidades de Lagunas y Ñamarín de la parroquia Saraguro en la provincia de Loja. Disertación de Licenciatura en Lingüística Aplicada, PUCE Quito.
sources.note: Sociolinguistic vitality survey; no phonology and nothing on stress (PDF is auth-restricted at PUCE; the DSpace text-extract bitstream was open).

sources.citation: Muysken, Pieter. 2019. El kichwa ecuatoriano: orígenes, riqueza, contactos. Quito: Abya-Yala.
